def check(candidate):
    import tempfile
    from pathlib import Path

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        root = Path(temp_dir)

        (root / "first.txt").write_text("A (hello world)! 123.", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "second.txt").write_text("(test)abc", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "ignored.csv").write_text("should be ignored", encoding="utf-8")

        print(candidate(temp_dir))

        custom_dir = root / "custom"
        custom_dir.mkdir()
        (custom_dir / "numbers.txt").write_text("item42 and 007", encoding="utf-8")
        print(candidate(str(custom_dir), r"\d+"))

        empty_dir = root / "empty"
        empty_dir.mkdir()
        print(candidate(str(empty_dir)))

        nested_dir = root / "nested"
        nested_dir.mkdir()
        (nested_dir / "data.txt").write_text("x(y)z", encoding="utf-8")
        print(candidate(str(nested_dir), r"\([^)]*\)|[a-z]"))
